note: Current season from BSD, INCREMENTAL: only newly finished matches are fetched and added to the accumulated totals (`_acc`). Same formulas as bsd_players.json — both use src/bsd.js. The app reads `players` and `team_matches`. Shot maps live in bsd_shots.json, not here. `team_matches` is ONE row per finished match with both sides' shot totals, written at ingest because that is the only moment the attribution exists: the per-player totals in `_acc` can never say who the opponent was, so team xGC (the sum of the OPPONENTS' xG) is not recoverable from them afterwards. `goals` there is counted from the shot map and reproduces the official scoreline exactly (measured on 2025/26: all 17 clubs, for and against), so it is the cross-check against fixtures.json rather than a second scoreline. A match whose shot map is missing gets NO row — not a row of zeros.
